_doc: Which creatures can bleed (Brandon, 3.3.3 play: lore-appropriate, data-driven).
A creature with no blood never takes the bleeding status, never loses health to it,
and is never called 'bleeding' (src/monster.py kind_can_bleed, read by Monster.can_bleed).
Checked in this order: the kind's own entry in `bleeds` or `bloodless`; a family in
`bleeding_families`; a family in `bloodless_families` or a tag in `bloodless_tags`;
otherwise it bleeds. Bone and dust undead, spirits, golems, elementals, oozes and
plants have no blood; vampires are full of it, and the fleshy dead (ghouls, zombies,
revenants, the Evil Dead's deadites, the wendigo) still bleed. Liches, bone witches,
the stiff jiangshi and Neferkaptah's mummy are dust and bone.
